desc:
🥚 Welcome to Jump To Steal Anime Eggs! ⚡

How to Play:
💪 Train your legs to increase your Jump Power
⬆️ Jump higher to reach new areas
🥚 Steal eggs guarded by powerful anime characters
🏃 Escape and bring the eggs back to your plot
🐣 Hatch eggs to discover rare anime characters
💰 Earn money from your characters—even while offline
🏋️ Upgrade your barbells, trails, and speed coils
✨ Discover rare sizes, Mythic eggs, and secret characters
📖 Complete your Anime Index and claim awesome rewards

How high can you jump, and can you collect them all?

👍 Like the game and join the group for rewards!
